about-us.title: About us
about-us.meta_title: About Beachrex – the beach guide with real photos and data
about-us.meta_description: Beachrex helps you find the right beach: thousands of beaches with photos, 360° views, videos and practical details such as access, parking and beach type.
about-us.content:
Beachrex helps you find the beach that suits you. Instead of general descriptions, we show each beach the way it really is: photos, 360° views, videos and the details that matter when you plan a day by the water.

What you will find on Beachrex

  • Thousands of beaches across Europe and beyond, organised by country, region, island and town.
  • Real photos, 360° views and videos of the beaches.
  • Practical details: beach type (sand, pebbles, rocks, concrete), access, parking, occupancy, shade, facilities and whether the beach is suitable for families.
  • An interactive beach map with filters, so you can find beaches near you or near your accommodation.
  • Sea temperature and weather for each beach.
  • An AI beach assistant that answers your questions and helps you plan a trip.

Our story

Beachrex started with a simple idea: show every beach as it really is, so that everyone can find the right one for their holiday. Over the years this grew into a large collection of beach photos, panoramas, videos and data. The new Beachrex brings all of it together in 19 languages.

Who is behind Beachrex

Beachrex is run by MOJA PLAŽA, d.o.o., Prušnikova ulica 22, 2000 Maribor, Slovenia. You can reach us at info@beachrex.com.

privacy-policy.title: Privacy policy
privacy-policy.meta_description: How Beachrex (MOJA PLAŽA, d.o.o.) collects, uses and protects your personal data, and what your rights are under the GDPR.
privacy-policy.content:
This privacy policy explains which personal data we process when you use beachrex.com, why we do so and what rights you have. We process personal data in line with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and the Slovenian Personal Data Protection Act (ZVOP-2).

1. Controller

MOJA PLAŽA, d.o.o., Prušnikova ulica 22, 2000 Maribor, Slovenia
Tax number: 53794214, registration number: 6791174000
E-mail: info@beachrex.com

2. Which data we process and why

Browsing the website

When you visit the website, our servers process technical data such as your IP address, browser type, the pages you open and the time of the visit. We need this data to deliver the website securely and to find errors (legitimate interest, Article 6(1)(f) GDPR). Server logs are kept for a short time and then deleted.

Sign-in with Google

If you sign in with your Google account, we receive your name, e-mail address and Google account ID from Google. We use them to create and manage your user account (performance of a contract, Article 6(1)(b) GDPR). We keep this data while your account exists.

Newsletter

If you subscribe to our newsletter, we store your e-mail address, the time of subscription and your consent in our own database. We use them only to send you news about Beachrex (consent, Article 6(1)(a) GDPR). You can unsubscribe at any time using the link in each e-mail or by writing to us.

AI beach assistant

When you use the AI assistant (chat or trip planner), your questions and the answers are processed to generate a reply. To generate replies we use an AI service provider (OpenAI). For anonymous use we store a pseudonymised (hashed) IP address to limit the number of requests. Please do not enter personal data in your questions.

Purchases

If you buy credits for AI trip plans, the payment is processed by Stripe. We do not receive or store your card details; we store the purchase, its amount and status (performance of a contract and legal obligations for accounting, Article 6(1)(b) and (c) GDPR).

Cookies, analytics and advertising

We use cookies and similar technologies. Necessary cookies are always active. Analytics (Google Analytics) and advertising cookies (Google AdSense) are used only with your consent, which you give or refuse in the cookie banner (CookieYes). Details are in our cookie policy.

Contacting us

If you write to us, we use your e-mail address and message to reply (legitimate interest). We keep the correspondence as long as needed to handle your request.

3. Processors and recipients

We use carefully selected providers who process data on our behalf:

  • Hetzner Online GmbH (Germany) – server hosting;
  • DigitalOcean (data centre in Frankfurt, Germany) – storage of images and videos;
  • Google Ireland Limited – sign-in with Google, Google Analytics, Google AdSense;
  • OpenAI – generating answers of the AI assistant;
  • Stripe – payment processing;
  • CookieYes – managing cookie consent.

Some providers may transfer data outside the European Economic Area (for example to the USA). In such cases transfers are based on an adequacy decision (EU–US Data Privacy Framework) or on the European Commission's standard contractual clauses.

4. How long we keep data

We keep personal data only as long as needed for the purpose for which we collected it, or as long as the law requires (for example accounting records). Data processed on the basis of consent is kept until you withdraw your consent.

5. Your rights

You have the right to access your data, to have it corrected or deleted, to restrict processing, to data portability and to object to processing based on legitimate interest. Where processing is based on consent, you can withdraw it at any time; this does not affect processing before the withdrawal. To exercise your rights, write to info@beachrex.com.

You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the supervisory authority: Information Commissioner of the Republic of Slovenia (Informacijski pooblaščenec), Dunajska cesta 22, 1000 Ljubljana, www.ip-rs.si.

6. Security

We protect personal data with appropriate technical and organisational measures, including encrypted connections (HTTPS) and restricted access.

7. Changes

We may update this privacy policy. The current version is always published on this page.

Last updated: 8 October 2026.

Types of cookies we use

  • Necessary cookies make the website work, for example remembering your language and your cookie choices. They do not need consent.
  • Analytics cookies (Google Analytics) help us understand how visitors use the website, so we can improve it. They are used only with your consent.
  • Advertising cookies (Google AdSense) are used to show and measure ads, possibly tailored to your interests. They are used only with your consent.

Your consent

When you first visit the website, a cookie banner lets you accept all cookies, reject non-necessary cookies or choose by category. You can change your choice at any time with the cookie settings button on the website. You can also delete cookies in your browser settings.

9. Liability

To the extent permitted by law, we are not liable for damage resulting from the use of the website or from relying on its information. This does not limit liability that cannot be excluded by law.

We may change these terms; the current version is always published on this page. Slovenian law applies. Consumers keep the protection of the mandatory law of their country of residence.

contribution-rules.title: Contribution rules
contribution-rules.meta_description: How to send photos, corrections and new beaches to Beachrex, and the rules for contributed content.
contribution-rules.content:
Beachrex grows with the help of beach lovers. If you would like to send a correction, a new beach or your photos, please follow these rules.

What you can send

  • corrections of beach information (beach type, access, parking, facilities);
  • new beaches with their exact location;
  • your own photos and videos of beaches.

Send your contribution to info@beachrex.com with the name and location of the beach.

Rules for photos and videos

  • Send only material that you made yourself and that you have the right to share.
  • People must not be recognisable without their consent; we will blur or reject such material.
  • No nudity, violence, advertising or offensive content.
  • The material must show the beach as it really is (no misleading edits).

Rights

By sending material you confirm that you own the rights to it and you grant MOJA PLAŽA, d.o.o. a free, non-exclusive, worldwide licence to publish it on Beachrex and in materials promoting Beachrex. You remain the author; on request we will state your name.

Review

We check every contribution before publishing and may edit, shorten or reject it without giving reasons.

ai-assistant-connector.title: Beachrex in your AI assistant
ai-assistant-connector.meta_title: Beachrex in Claude, ChatGPT and other AI assistants
ai-assistant-connector.meta_description: Connect Beachrex to Claude, ChatGPT or another AI assistant and ask about beaches in your own language, with real Beachrex data and links.
ai-assistant-connector.content:
Beachrex works inside AI assistants that support MCP (Model Context Protocol). Once connected, you can ask your assistant about beaches in your own language and it answers with real Beachrex data: beach type, access, parking, family suitability, weather and sea temperature, with links to the beach pages.

For example: "Find a quiet sandy beach for families near Zadar" or "Which beaches on Krk have parking and shade?"

Connector address

https://mcp.beachrex.com/mcp

The connector is free and needs no account or key. It only reads public Beachrex beach data.

Claude

  1. Open Claude (claude.ai or the desktop app) and go to Settings → Connectors.
  2. Choose Add custom connector.
  3. Name: Beachrex. URL: https://mcp.beachrex.com/mcp. Save.
  4. In a new chat, turn on Beachrex in the tools menu and ask about beaches.

ChatGPT

  1. Open Settings → Apps & Connectors. Custom connectors may require turning on Developer mode under Advanced settings, depending on your plan.
  2. Choose Create (new connector), name it Beachrex and enter the URL https://mcp.beachrex.com/mcp. No authentication is needed.
  3. In a new chat, select Beachrex and ask about beaches.

Other assistants and tools

Any app that supports remote MCP servers (Streamable HTTP), such as Cursor or other AI tools, can use the same URL: https://mcp.beachrex.com/mcp. Add it as a remote MCP server in the app's settings.

Good to know

  • Menu names in AI apps change often; if a step looks different, look for "connectors" or "MCP" in the app's settings.
  • Your questions are processed by the AI assistant you use, under its own terms. Beachrex receives only the search requests needed to answer, without your name or account.
  • Questions or problems: info@beachrex.com.

media-kit.title: Media kit
media-kit.meta_title: Media kit – logos and brand guidelines | Beachrex
media-kit.meta_description: Download the Beachrex logo in every version and format, the brand colours and the brand guidelines for articles, partners and promotion.
media-kit.content:
Logos, colours and brand guidelines for journalists, partners and anyone who writes about Beachrex. All files are available for download below this text.

The logo

The logo combines a sun rising over the horizon with the Beachrex wordmark.

  • Horizontal – the primary version, use it whenever there is room.
  • Stacked – for narrow or square spaces.
  • Symbol – only where the brand is already clear, for example as an app icon, favicon or profile picture.
  • Wordmark – the name alone, where the symbol does not fit.

Colours and backgrounds

  • Use the full-colour logo on white or light backgrounds.
  • On teal, dark or photographic backgrounds, use the white logo.
  • The black logo is for single-colour print and stamps.
  • The teal and orange one-colour logos are for embroidery, engraving and one-colour printing.

The primary colours are Beachrex Teal (#00B2C9, the sea) and Beachrex Orange (#EB8751, the sun). Deep Sea (#0F3B45) and Sand (#FFF4E8) are supporting colours.

Clear space and minimum size

Keep clear space around the logo at least as large as the height of the letter “e” in the wordmark. Do not place text or other graphics in this area.

  • Horizontal: at least 140 px on screen or 35 mm in print.
  • Stacked: at least 80 px or 20 mm.
  • Wordmark: at least 100 px or 25 mm.
  • Symbol: at least 16 px or 8 mm.

What not to do

  • Do not stretch, squash or rotate the logo.
  • Do not change its colours or add shadows or other effects.
  • Do not place the full-colour logo on teal or orange backgrounds.
  • Do not retype the name in another typeface – always use the supplied files.

Photos and content

The photos, 360° views and videos on Beachrex are our own work and are protected by copyright. You may use the logo and the files on this page when writing about Beachrex. Photos may not be used without our permission. If you need photos for an article, write to us and we will send them together with the terms of use. Please credit them as “Photo: Beachrex”.

Contact

For media enquiries, interviews and photos, write to info@beachrex.com.
